key_insight: Machine learning and multi-omics identified cytokine signatures associated with ICI myocarditis, with JAK-STAT signaling emerging across cohorts and showing amplification in CHIP carriers.
clinical_relevance: These findings nominate cytokine-based risk assessment and JAK-STAT-targeted treatment as research strategies, not established clinical tools.
method: Machine learning and explainable AI analyzed cytokine profiles from ICI-treated patients.
Single-cell multi-omics mapped immune-cell contributions and inflammatory pathways across three cohorts.
Stanford CyTOF data validated Yale proteomic analyses.
evidence_signal: The study enrolled 236 cardio-oncology patients, including 88 receiving ICI, and analyzed single-cell cohorts from Yale (n=19), Stanford (n=25), and MGH (n=63).
watch_item: The abstract reports associations but no predictive-performance metrics or treatment efficacy; clinical implementation requires prospective validation.
paper_title: Cytokine Signatures of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Myocarditis and the Modifying Role of Clonal Hematopoiesis: A Machine-Learning and Multi-Omics Study
